warning: These are *original modern teaching adaptations*, NOT verified note-for-note re-engravings of the 1812 score. They must not be treated as facsimile ground truth against the scan.

source.author: Charles Stewart Ashworth
source.work: A New, Useful and Complete System of Drum Beating

format.hand_mapping: Immediately preceding MIDI lyric meta event (FF 05) text R or L on the same percussion track and absolute tick as the note-on
format.grace_implementation: Short, separately sounded low-velocity MIDI strikes just before primary notes; local beat-0 grace is given a small pre-beat margin inside the bar.
format.notation: One-bar-per-system, single-line snare stave; grace strokes, accents, sextuplet/triplet figures, sticking.
format.midi_pitch_and_durations: GM snare 38; note-offs use short percussion gates (notation duration shown in JSON).
format.license_new_material: No exclusive rights claimed by this generated package; review applicable terms for reuse.
